thread:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: policy 'hosted-inference-us' fired — HIGH error_rate + retries. Incident PD-70102. Primary: kai. Secondary: noor. Manager: ashley-se. Auto-escalation sequence started.
kai: getting this on my watch now, phone was muted due to focus time. trying to ack.
pagerduty-bot: 45s until auto-escalation to secondary (noor). (reaction :alarm_clock:)
noor: in a customer call, pinged my laptop. if it escalates to me I'll hop off and join. quick ask: any idea impact surface?
marta-cs: support queue — ~21 incidents over last 12m. biggest: payment gateway clients seeing 502s during tokenization calls; a couple of high-volume customers reporting increased latency and error spikes.
incidentbot: metrics snapshot:
```
region: us-west-2
metric: request_retry_rate / http_5xx_rate
window: 1m
retry_rate: 12% (norm ~0.5%)
5xx_rate: 3.8% (norm 0.02%)
QPS: 2200 (baseline 900)
affected_routes: /v1/tokenize, /v1/generate-stream
```
(automated: anomaly correlated with recent kernel-chooser pilot deployed 9m ago; rollout id rc-2026-07-11-ker)
pagerduty-bot: Auto-escalation: no ack from primary observed -> escalated to noor. Manager will be paged if no ack within 4m.
kai: acked via web at 3123459999+72 (173...). sorry folks, DND messed with notifications — ack at 3123460068.
noor: acked at 3123460072. joining bridge. starting live triage.
nashley-se: I'm on standby. if manager page arrives I'll join. what's the mitigation plan?
nashley-se: (thinking) can we flip traffic for tokenization to cached-tokenizer or short-circuit retries? retries are amplifying backend load.
noor: propose immediate actions: 1) disable client-side auto-retries at edge for 3m; 2) route tokenization to token-cache cluster; 3) roll back kernel-chooser pilot.
nashley-se: approve. keep comms simple to customers: we're toggling retries and routing to fallback cluster, ETA 10-15m. marta-cs please post.
marta-cs: will post updated advisory now — including that we may see higher latency on fallback but fewer failures.
nashley-se: noor, can you run the rollback? command snippet:
```
rictl rollout undo --model-kernel kernel-chooser-rc-2026-07-11 --region us-west-2 --to-revision previous
```
noor: running rollback now.
incidentbot: rollback initiated. expected completion ~60s.
noor: disabling retries at edge: `edgectl set-rate-limiter --route /v1/tokenize --retry 0 --window 60s`
incidentbot: edge config applied. retry amplification should stop.
noor: routing % of tokenization to cache cluster:
```
rictl routing update --region us-west-2 --route /v1/tokenize --to token-cache-usw --weight 80
```
incidentbot: Routing change detected: 77% traffic to token-cache-usw. 5xx -> 1.1% over 30s, retry_rate -> 1.6%. Latency p50 -> +90ms on cache.
kai: noticing `runtime: kv cache thrash -> repeated load -> OOM` in logs. suspect kernel chooser changed placement strategy causing hotspotting of large-kv contexts. gathering heap profiles.
noor: I've also proactively scaled up token-cache cluster by +4 nodes: `infractl scale --cluster token-cache-usw --add-nodes 4` (eta ~80s).
pagebot: PagerDuty: manager escalation triggered (no ack from primary + secondary within window) due to initial delay. Manager ashley-se notified.
ashley-se: I saw the ping and am on the bridge. thanks for fast routing.
marta-cs: customers updated: advisory posted, open tickets consolidated into PD-70102. one large customer (global-payments-inc) asked for an incident call; scheduled for 20m unless fully mitigated.
noor: heapdumps and kv metrics uploaded to s3: s3://ri-logs/PD-70102/ (link: https://s3.redwood/ri-logs/PD-70102)
kai: rolling restart of 5 affected runtime pods to clear KV and GC churn: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime -n us-west-2 --selector=thrashed=true`
incidentbot: Restart in progress.
incidentbot: Metrics update: 5xx -> 0.6% (1m avg), retry_rate -> 0.3%. p50 latency steady at +110ms. Partial mitigation achieved.
noor: rolling restart helped. kernel-chooser rollback confirmed. will mark the pilot as blocked until we do deeper testing.
nashley-se: action items: kai (root cause analysis + kernel chooser instrumentation), noor (post-deploy rollout gating & rollback automation), ops (PD policy tweak: add 2m sustained window and combined-signal threshold), marta-cs (customer followups and SLA impact). I'll own the postmortem.
pagerduty-bot: PD-70102 acknowledged by kai and noor. Manager escalation cleared. Closing escalation chain. Next update in 45m or on regression. :white_check_mark:
